tickerText: [TENNIS] Shelton beats Tien 6-2, 6-3 and Nakashima tops Jodar 7-6(3), 6-4 to set the first all-American Montreal Masters final since 2003 — Shelton bids to repeat today • [SQUASH] Marek Panacek stuns top seed Patrick Rooney 3-1 at PSA Valencia Memorial; quarter-finals play today as London Classic Gold event looms Sept 1 • [BADMINTON] BWF Worlds open in Delhi Aug 17–23 — Shi Yu Qi vs Ayush Shetty headline R1; An Se Young and PV Sindhu lead India's medal push • [PICKLEBALL] Carvana PPA unveils World Pickleball Rankings blending all three formats; PPA Tour Europe launches 20-event circuit across nine countries • [TABLE TENNIS] Ovtcharov ousts defending champ Moregard 3-0 at WTT Europe Smash Malmö; Wang Manyu returns from injury with a 16-min 3-0 over Meshref

newsItems.title: Panacek Stuns Rooney in Valencia
newsItems.excerpt: Czech Marek Panacek upset top seed Patrick Rooney 3-1 at the PSA Valencia Memorial Chimo Marmaneu as quarter-finals get underway in Spain through Aug 15.

newsItems.title: Delhi Countdown Begins
newsItems.excerpt: BWF World Championships open Aug 17 at Indira Gandhi Arena — defending champ Shi Yu Qi faces India's Ayush Shetty in a blockbuster R1 as An Se Young and PV Sindhu head the field.

newsItems.title: PPA Debuts World Rankings
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA Tour launched unified World Pickleball Rankings for 2026–27, weighting gender doubles, mixed and singles across one global leaderboard ahead of the Cary season opener.

newsItems.title: Moregard Out in Malmö
newsItems.excerpt: Defending WTT Europe Smash champion Truls Moregard fell 3-0 to Dimitrij Ovtcharov in round one; Wang Manyu marked her injury return with a 16-minute sweep of Dina Meshref.
